units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 8a:10">Ab. Zar. 8ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="H01847"><he>חָשַׁךְ</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>חֲשׁוּכִּים</he>, <he>כִּין …</he>; f. <he>חֲשׁוּכּוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 7:5">Bekh. VII, 5</cite> (expl. <he>מרוח אשך</he>, <cite ref="Leviticus 21:20">Lev. XXI, 20</cite>) <he>שמראיו ח׳</he> whose complexion is very dark.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 258">Yalk. Ex. 258</cite> <he>פנים ח׳</he> dark (frowning) countenance; Mekh. B’shall., Vayassa, s. 2 <he>חֲשֵׁכוֹת</he>.
Pesik. R. s. 6, beg. (ref. to Prov. XXII, 29) פרעה הח׳ Pharaoh, the benighted.—Pl. as ab.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1">Cant. R. to I, 1</cite> (ref. to Prov. l. c.) <he>לפני ח׳ אלו הרשעים</he> ‘before the benighted’ that means the wicked.
